name: mcAI
description: Chat with an AI from the Minecraft chat bar via the '!ai' prefix, press H to send a screenshot to a multimodal model, press R to send only the region you select, and press G to analyse a build or redstone circuit. Local models (Ollama / LM Studio) need no API key. Includes multi-turn context kept per world, a local answer cache, cost estimation with a daily budget cap and a warning before you hit it, multiple API keys with automatic failover, persona presets and long-term memories, sign/book translation, a world-context advisor, a local recipe helper that costs no tokens, death recap and Discord webhooks, a danger alert, streaming output, cancellable requests, clickable coordinates in answers, an optional screenshot preview and privacy mask, optional text-to-speech, and a fully localized UI in English / 简体中文 / 繁體中文 / 日本語.
